screensaver.name: nebulae
screensaver._description:
Slow fly-throughs of volumetric nebulae and stellar nurseries.
Each nebula is generated fresh: a star cluster carving a cavity with dust pillars, a wind-blown bubble, or a dark dust cloud lit blue by nearby stars. The camera tours the most interesting places, and as it arrives a protostar ignites in a dense core, lights up the gas around it and launches jets.
In continuous mode the flight never ends: the camera keeps touring, new stars keep igniting all around, and when it is time for a new nebula the old one dissolves and the next condenses around the camera without a break. (Unless you move the slider, each nebula then lasts about six minutes.)
